Item.Name: SUB_PROD_TYPES
Item.Hint: Enter one or more sub product types separated by comma.
Item.Label: Bag Volume

Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE
 v_string varchar2(200);
 p_length number:=0;
 nCounter number:=1;
 L1 number:=1;
 nCount NUMBER:=0;
 pl_prod_type varchar2(240);
BEGIN
 
If :catalog_details.sub_prod_types is not null then 
 
 v_string:=:catalog_details.sub_prod_types;
 
 LOOP
 
 L1:=instr(v_string,',',nCounter);
 
 If L1 > 0 then 
 pl_prod_type:=substr(v_string,nCounter,L1-nCounter); 
 
 --message('String='||v_string|| ' L1='||to_char(L1)|| ' pl prod type= '||pl_prod_type||' counter='||to_char(nCounter)); pause;
 
 If pl_prod_type='NONE' then 
 null;
 Else 
 select nvl(count(*),0) into nCount from valid_products where
 product_type=LTrim(pl_prod_type) and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date, sysdate+10);
 
 If nCount = 0 then 
 show_error('1245',pl_prod_type);
 check_package_failure;
 End If;
 End If;
 
 Else
 pl_prod_type:=substr(v_string,nCounter,length(v_string)-nCounter+1);
 
 -- message('String= L0'||v_string|| ' L1='||to_char(L1)|| ' pl prod type= '||pl_prod_type||' counter='||to_char(nCounter)); pause;
 
 if pl_prod_type='NONE' then
 null;
 else 
 select nvl(count(*),0) into nCount from valid_products where
 product_type=LTRIM(pl_prod_type) and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date, sysdate+10);
 
 If nCount = 0 then 
 show_error('1245',pl_prod_type);
 check_package_failure;
 End If;
 end if; 
 End If;
 
 
 nCounter:=L1+1;
 exit when Length(v_string) < nCounter or (L1=0);
 
 END LOOP;
 Else
 NULL;
 End If;
 
 END;

ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
-- Proc modified to fix the issue of application freezing.
-- On 03/01/2012 by Arun (IM 6852)
-- Modifief the logic to display messages like Transaction Committed etc. (14-mar-2012)
PROCEDURE show_error_local 
 (
 error_cd IN VARCHAR2
 ,add_msg IN VARCHAR2 := ''
 )
IS
 text VARCHAR2(80);
 temp_audit_flag VARCHAR2(1);
 temp_error_type VARCHAR2(1);
 usr_id VARCHAR2(30) := NAME_IN('banner.user_id');
 current_form VARCHAR2(60) := NAME_IN('system.current_form');
 user_err_error_cd VARCHAR2(80);
 user_err_unit_id VARCHAR2(80); 
 user_err_chapter_id VARCHAR2(80);
 user_err_coll_date VARCHAR2(20);
 user_err_component_prefix VARCHAR2(80);
 user_err_product_code VARCHAR2(20); 
 err_type VARCHAR2(10);
 err_text VARCHAR2(500);
 
 PROCEDURE disp_msg
 (
 temp_err_typ IN VARCHAR2
 ,err_typ IN VARCHAR2 DEFAULT 'Note '
 ,err_txt IN VARCHAR2
 )
 IS
 al_id ALERT;
 al_btn NUMBER :=0;
 BEGIN
 IF UPPER(temp_err_typ) = 'E'
 THEN
 al_id := FIND_ALERT('ERR_ALERT');
 ELSIF UPPER(temp_err_typ) = 'W'
 THEN
 al_id := FIND_ALERT('WNG_ALERT');
 ELSE
 al_id := FIND_ALERT('MSG_ALERT');
 END IF;
 
 IF temp_err_typ in ('E','e','m','w','W')
 THEN
 IF ID_NULL(al_id)
 THEN
 COPY('N','GLOBAL.accept');
 SYNCHRONIZE;
 MESSAGE('Enter Response',no_acknowledge);
 COPY(err_txt||'.','GLOBAL.error_message') ;
 CALL_FORM( LOWER('ERROR') ,NO_HIDE);
 ELSE
 SET_ALERT_PROPERTY(al_id,TITLE,err_typ);
 SET_ALERT_PROPERTY(al_id,ALERT_MESSAGE_TEXT,err_txt);
 al_btn := SHOW_ALERT(al_id);
 IF UPPER(temp_err_typ) = 'W'
 THEN
 IF al_btn = ALERT_BUTTON1
 THEN
 COPY('Y','GLOBAL.accept');
 ELSE
 COPY('N','GLOBAL.accept');
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 ELSE
 MESSAGE(err_txt);
 END IF;
 END disp_msg;
 
BEGIN
 SELECT error_type
 ,DECODE
 (
 error_type
 ,'E','Err:'||error_code
 ,'e','Err:'||error_code
 ,'M','Msg:'||error_code
 ,'m','Msg:'||error_code
 ,'W','Warn:'||error_code
 ,'w','Warn:'||error_code
 ,''||error_code
 )||': '||NVL(error,'Error missing')
 ,audit_flag
-- ,error_type
 ,DECODE
 (
 UPPER(error_type)
 ,'E','Error ! '
 ,'M','Message '
 ,'W','Warning ! '
 ,''
 )
 INTO temp_error_type
 ,text
 ,temp_audit_flag
 -- ,temp_error_type
 ,err_type
 FROM valid_errors
 WHERE error_code = error_cd
 ;
 message('Temp Err Type: ' || temp_error_type); pause;
 --
 COPY(NULL,'GLOBAL.accept');
 
 if temp_error_type in ('e', 'm', 'w', 'W') then -- Added by Kishore on 01/07/2014. IM 9242
 message('Test'); pause;
 IF add_msg IS NULL THEN
 err_text := text || '.';
 ELSE
 err_text := text || ' ' || add_msg || '.';
 END IF;
 disp_msg(temp_error_type, err_type, err_text);
 else -- Added by Kishore on 01/07/2014. IM 9242
 message('Test1'); pause;
 -- Added by Kishore on 01/07/2014. IM 9242
 if add_msg is null then
 message(text || '.');
 else
 message(text|| add_msg || '.');
 end if;
 -- End of change 
 end if; -- Added by Kishore on 01/07/2014. IM 9242
 
 IF temp_audit_flag = 'Y'
 THEN
 BEGIN
 DEFAULT_VALUE('','GLOBAL.user_err_unit_id');
 DEFAULT_VALUE('','GLOBAL.user_err_chapter_id');
 DEFAULT_VALUE('','GLOBAL.user_err_coll_date');
 DEFAULT_VALUE('','GLOBAL.user_err_component_prefix');
 DEFAULT_VALUE('','GLOBAL.user_err_product_code');
 DEFAULT_VALUE('','GLOBAL.user_err_SYSDATE');
 DEFAULT_VALUE('','GLOBAL.user_err_error_cd');
 COPY(to_char(SYSDATE,'DD-MON-YY HH24:MI:SS'),
 'GLOBAL.user_err_SYSDATE');
 COPY(error_cd,'GLOBAL.user_err_error_cd'); 
 user_err_error_cd := NAME_IN('global.user_err_error_cd');
 user_err_unit_id := NAME_IN('global.user_err_unit_id'); 
 user_err_chapter_id := NAME_IN('global.user_err_chapter_id');
 user_err_coll_date := NAME_IN('global.user_err_coll_date');
 user_err_component_prefix := NAME_IN('global.user_err_component_prefix');
 user_err_product_code := NAME_IN('global.user_err_product_code'); 

 INSERT INTO user_error_log_tmp
 (
 insert_dats
 ,user_id
 ,program_name
 ,error_code
 ,unit_id
 ,chapter_id
 ,coll_date
 ,component_prefix
 ,product_code
 )
 VALUES
 (
 SYSDATE
 ,usr_id
 ,current_form
 ,user_err_error_cd
 ,user_err_unit_id
 ,user_err_chapter_id
 ,user_err_coll_date
 ,user_err_component_prefix
 ,user_err_product_code
 )
 ; 

 /* The user exit -user error was replaced by the local procedure by Edwin on 08.14.2001 to
 get rid of the user exits */
 COPY(current_form,'GLOBAL.user_err_prog_name');
 COPY(usr_id,'GLOBAL.user_err_user_id');
 GENERATE_USER_ERROR; -- Added by Kishore on 08/10/2011. SCR 18564
 IF NOT FORM_SUCCESS
 THEN
 MESSAGE('User exit to trap user error failed');
 END IF;
 COPY(NULL,'GLOBAL.user_err_unit_id');
 COPY(NULL,'GLOBAL.user_err_chapter_id');
 COPY(NULL,'GLOBAL.user_err_coll_date');
 COPY(NULL,'GLOBAL.user_err_component_prefix');
 COPY(NULL,'GLOBAL.user_err_product_code');
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS
 THEN
 NULL; 
 END;
 END IF;
 IF (NAME_IN('GLOBAL.accept')= 'N' OR temp_error_type = 'E') AND 
 UPPER(temp_error_type) != 'M' 
 THEN
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND
 THEN
 MESSAGE( 'Err:No error description for error code '||error_cd);
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 WHEN TOO_MANY_ROWS
 THEN
 MESSAGE( 'Err:Too many descriptions for error code '||error_cd);
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
END;
